paper_title: Organic Single Crystals with High Photoluminescence Quantum Yields Close to 100% and High Mobility for Optoelectronic Devices
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Materials - 2021 - Tao - Organic Single Crystals with High Photoluminescence Quantum Yields Close to 100  and High/auto/Advanced Materials - 2021 - Tao - Organic Single Crystals with High Photoluminescence Quantum Yields Close to 100  and High.md

knowledge_points.content: The molecular design of TPA-An and TBA-An involves introducing triphenylamine and 1,3-diphenylbenzene groups at the 9,10 positions of an anthracene core via triple bond connections to expand the π-conjugation length and improve mobility.
knowledge_points.evidence: two compounds 9,10-bis([N,N-diphenyl] 4'-phenylethynyl)anthracene (TPA-An) and 9,10-bis([1',3'-diphenyl]-5'-phenylethynyl)anthracene (TBA-An) are synthesized by introducing two different luminescent groups... at the 9,10 positions of anthracene via triple bond connection.

knowledge_points.content: TPA-An and TBA-An single crystals exhibit exceptionally high photoluminescence quantum yields (PLQYs) of 98% and 99%, respectively, at room temperature.
knowledge_points.evidence: Single crystals based on TPA-An and TBA-An... exhibit high photoluminescence quantum yields (PLQYs) of 98% and 99% at room temperature

knowledge_points.content: The hole mobilities of TPA-An and TBA-An in single-crystal organic field-effect transistors (SC-OFETs) reach maximum values of 0.45 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and 0.15 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, respectively.
knowledge_points.evidence: remarkable hole mobilities of 0.45 and 0.15 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ in single-crystal organic field-effect transistors (SC-OFETs).

knowledge_points.content: TPA-An exhibits higher mobility than TBA-An because it possesses more intermolecular C-H...π interactions (2.868–2.949 Å) and a more delocalized HOMO electron cloud distribution, despite having larger dihedral angles (44.06° vs. ~3-6°).
knowledge_points.evidence: Although the dihedral angles of TBA-An molecule are smaller than that of TPA-An molecule, there are more intermolecular interactions in TPA-An single crystals... The electron cloud distribution of TPA-An HOMO energy level is more delocalized than that of TBA-An, indicating that TPA-An has better charge carrier mobility

knowledge_points.content: The HOMO levels of TPA-An and TBA-An are -5.32 eV and -5.60 eV, respectively, while their optical bandgaps are 2.22 eV and 2.19 eV.
knowledge_points.evidence: The highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) levels for TPA-An and TBA-An were -5.32 and -5.60 eV... The respective optical bandgaps for TPA-An and TBA-An calculated by the onset absorption in their films were 2.22 and 2.19 eV

knowledge_points.content: TPA-An and TBA-An UV phototransistors achieve ultrahigh detectivities (D*) of 1.40 x 10^16 Jones and 1.60 x 10^17 Jones, respectively, under 370 nm light illumination.
knowledge_points.evidence: the detectivities exceeding 1.40 x 10^16 and 1.60 x 10^17 Jones... upon an illumination of 370 nm light.

knowledge_points.content: The exciton binding energies (Eb) for TPA-An and TBA-An single crystals are 53.57 meV and 83.29 meV, respectively, which facilitates temperature-activated exciton dissociation into photogenerated carriers at room temperature.
knowledge_points.evidence: the lower binding energies, EB, of 53.57 meV (TPA-An) and 83.29 meV (TBA-An) were obtained... the fluorescence emission intensities... decrease with the increase of temperature, due to the temperature-activated exciton dissociation

knowledge_points.content: Single crystals of TPA-An and TBA-An with ribbon morphology were grown using a slow solvent vapor-diffusion method, utilizing chloroform/n-hexane and chloroform/methanol solvent systems.
knowledge_points.evidence: Two crystals of TPA-An and TBA-An are prepared by the slow solvent vapor-diffusion method... high-quality ribbon crystals were grown in chloroform/n-hexane solution and chloroform/methanol solution, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The quality and orientation of the single crystals on substrates were confirmed using X-ray diffraction (XRD), which showed (00h) facet reflections corresponding to interlayer distances of 14.38 Å for TPA-An and 17.44 Å for TBA-An.
knowledge_points.evidence: The diffraction peaks corresponding to (00h) facet reflections for TPA-An and TBA-An single crystals on substrates were observed... The interlayer distances in TPA-An and TBA-An crystals on substrates... were 14.38 and 17.44 Å

knowledge_points.content: Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) indicates that TPA-An and TBA-An are thermally stable up to 489 °C and 522 °C, respectively (based on 5% weight loss).
knowledge_points.evidence: TPA-An and TBA-An show good stability sublimating at 489 and 522 °C from thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) data (corresponding to 5% weight loss)

knowledge_points.content: The high PLQY in the solid state (near 100%) compared to the solution state (~80%) is attributed to the restriction of intramolecular vibration and rotation of the benzene rings within the compact crystal packing.
knowledge_points.evidence: The reason for higher PLQYs of TPA-An and TBA-An single crystals is that the intermolecular interactions in the single crystals restricted the vibration and rotation of benzene rings... resulting in the enhancement of the fluorescence emission

knowledge_points.content: Under 370 nm illumination at an intensity of 0.0002 mW cm⁻², the TPA-An phototransistor exhibits a photoresponsivity (R) of 7.19 x 10^5 A/W.
knowledge_points.evidence: Under 0.0002 mW cm⁻² 370 nm wavelength illumination... ultrahigh photoresponsivities reached 7.19 x 10^5... A W⁻¹
